players.product: On-site power generation for AI data centers and large loads (Liberty Power Innovations: multi-OEM engine generation stacks with BESS, energy management and ERCOT/PJM market participation)

quarterly_data.signal: Liberty's Q2 2026 earnings release (8-K): revenue was $1,188,596 thousand, up 14% from $1,042,521 thousand in Q2 2025; first-half 2026 revenue was $2,209,780 thousand (first half 2025: $2,019,982 thousand). Liberty commenced commercial operations of SLXRRY, its proprietary last-mile sand slurry delivery system, which the company says enables lower delivered sand costs and reduced truck traffic, road wear, dust and emissions.
